general.title: Nordic Alliance Seeks One Public Market to Stem Listings to US
general.summary: The Nordic region should create a single public market for stocks and other securities to attract more international capital and keep its most promising companies from pursuing listings in the US, according to the Nordic Compass business alliance.

general.title: Rheinmetall Cuts 2026 Sales Guidance, Shares Plunge
general.summary: German defense firm Rheinmetall cut its 2026 sales target for the second time, citing delays with the Boxer armored vehicle program that would push orders into next year. Bloomberg's Benedikt Kammel has the details. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Micron Pauses Work on $4.5 Billion Taiwan Plant After Labor Spat
general.summary: Micron Technology Inc. has suspended plans for a memory chip plant in Taiwan due to a protracted labor dispute, according to people familiar with the matter, throwing into question the fate of a major production base for crucial AI components.
